# Azaël Iloki — Language Services (Lomé, Togo)

> Sworn (court-accredited) French ↔ English translator and language instructor at Institut Français du Togo.

Website: https://azaeliloki.com/
Contact: contact@azaeliloki.com · WhatsApp +228 79 71 62 58
Address: Lomé, Maritime, TG
Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00, Sat 08:00–18:00 (GMT+0)
Currency: XOF (FCFA)

Core facts, quotable:

- A certified (sworn) translation of a personal or civil document costs **15,000–20,000 FCFA per page** and typically takes **2–3 business days**. Express 24h adds 50%. Corporate and legal documents (contracts, judgments, audits) are quoted per source word at **66–118 FCFA**, never per page.
- Accreditation: Cour d'appel de Lomé (sworn translator / interpreter).
- Languages: sworn translation is **French ↔ English only**. Transcription also covers national languages (Ewe, Kabiye, Tem), delivered with a signed statement of fidelity rather than a sworn certification.
- General B2B translation: **66–118 FCFA per word**.
- Language courses: from **35,000 FCFA/month** (online); in-person from **45,000 FCFA/month**.
- Academic tutoring: from **30,000 FCFA/month**.
- Corporate training: from **100,000 FCFA/month** HT (Duo Circle, 4 workshops/month, max 3 staff). Standard Circle is 200,000 FCFA/month HT for 8 workshops/month, max 5 staff.
- Web content & SEO translation retainer: from **180,000 FCFA/month**.
- Transcription and translation of recordings: from **4,000 FCFA per recorded minute** (FR ↔ EN), from **6,500 FCFA per recorded minute** from a national language.
- Interpretation (liaison/consecutive): half-day **150,000 FCFA HT**, full day **250,000 FCFA HT**. Delivered through vetted collaborators, arranged and managed by Azaël.
- Aviation English (ICAO Level 4): **315,000 FCFA / 12 sessions of 90 minutes** online, 345,000 in person; employer-funded 25,000 FCFA/hour HT. Sessions run over 6 to 12 weeks.
- Quotations are returned within **2 working hours**.

## Services — English

- [Home](https://azaeliloki.com/): what a sworn translator is, who the services are for, and the published rates.
- [Certified translation](https://azaeliloki.com/certified-translation/): sworn FR↔EN translation of diplomas, civil records and visa files; 15,000–20,000 FCFA per page.
- [Business translation and training](https://azaeliloki.com/business/): B2B translation at 66–118 FCFA per source word, plus corporate language training.
- [Law firms and notaries](https://azaeliloki.com/law-firms/): firm rate, referral retainer, and billing either to the firm or direct to the end client.
- [Web content and SEO](https://azaeliloki.com/content-translation/): monthly article and page translation retainers from 180,000 FCFA/month HT.
- [Interpretation](https://azaeliloki.com/interpretation/): liaison and consecutive interpreting from 150,000 FCFA HT per half-day.
- [Language courses](https://azaeliloki.com/courses/): adult English and French, online or in person in Lomé.
- [Academic tutoring](https://azaeliloki.com/tutoring/): BAC and BEPC preparation from 30,000 FCFA/month.
- [Transcription of recordings](https://azaeliloki.com/transcription/): from 4,000 FCFA per recorded minute; national languages from 6,500.
- [Aviation English (ICAO)](https://azaeliloki.com/icao-english/): ICAO Level 4 preparation, 315,000 FCFA per 12 sessions online.
- [Visa document guide](https://azaeliloki.com/guides/visa-documents/): which documents a visa or study file needs certified.

## Services — Français

- [Accueil](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/): ce qu'est un traducteur assermenté, à qui s'adressent les services, et les tarifs publiés.
- [Traduction certifiée](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/traduction-certifiee/): traduction assermentée FR↔EN, 15 000–20 000 FCFA la page.
- [Entreprise et formation](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/business/): traduction B2B à 66–118 FCFA le mot source et formation linguistique en entreprise.
- [Cabinets juridiques](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/cabinets-juridiques/): tarif cabinet, abonnement prescripteur, facturation au cabinet ou au client final.
- [Contenu web et SEO](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/contenu-web/): formules mensuelles de traduction d'articles dès 180 000 FCFA/mois HT.
- [Interprétation](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/interpretation/): liaison et consécutive dès 150 000 FCFA HT la demi-journée.
- [Cours de langues](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/courses/): anglais et français pour adultes, en ligne ou à Lomé.
- [Soutien scolaire](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/soutien-scolaire/): préparation au BAC et au BEPC dès 30 000 FCFA/mois.
- [Transcription d'enregistrements](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/transcription/): dès 4 000 FCFA la minute enregistrée; langues nationales dès 6 500.
- [Anglais aéronautique (OACI)](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/anglais-aeronautique/): préparation OACI niveau 4, 315 000 FCFA les 12 séances en ligne.
- [Guide des documents de visa](https://azaeliloki.com/fr/guides/documents-visa/): les pièces qui exigent une traduction certifiée.
